hints.title: Core Insight
hints.text: Track the greatest common divisor pair (g1, g2) obtained by assigning previous elements into subsequence 1, subsequence 2, or neither.

hints.title: Algorithmic Structure
hints.text: When visiting a number x, transition to new pairs by combining x into g1, into g2, or skipping x altogether.

hints.title: State Transitions
hints.text: Sum all entries where both g1 and g2 are strictly greater than zero and equal to each other modulo 10^9+7.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Evaluates in optimal O(n * M^2) runtime.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Brute-force exhaustive search exceeds the time limit.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Uses O(M^2) auxiliary memory for optimal state tracking.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identifies optimal pattern to achieve O(n * M^2) complexity.
